Rina Alvarez (CSM): quick weekly check for Holloway: dropping p95/p99 numbers by route+model, streaming vs sync. flagged a p99 tail on Wed evening.
Carlos Mendes (SRE): rolling numbers (7d):
Carlos Mendes (SRE): route=chat.completions, model=rw-chat-3: streaming p95=240ms p99=680ms; sync p95=400ms p99=1.05s.
Carlos Mendes (SRE): route=embed.text, model=rw-embed-2: sync only p95=48ms p99=135ms.
Carlos Mendes (SRE): route=rerank, model=rw-rank-2: streaming p95=210ms p99=540ms; sync p95=280ms p99=710ms.
Rina Alvarez (CSM): notes: streaming improves median/p95 on chat but not enough on p99 — tail remains.
Jared Holt (Holloway Analytics): we saw the lag during our 18:00 demo window Wed — users reported slow replies. is that the p99 bump?
Carlos Mendes (SRE): yes — correlates. autoscaler scaled but with ~50s delay; concurrent sessions jumped ~35% from baseline 18:05-18:25 UTC.
AlertBot: incident-signal: autoscaler_surge  service=chat.completions peak_concurrency=620 duration=1200s link=https://telemetry/incident/5549
Priya Kapoor (Onboarding): FYI some trial workspaces are hitting the canary rw-small-beta this week; that can increase tails under load.
Carlos Mendes (SRE): confirmed 11% of traffic routed to rw-small-beta between 18:00-18:30 UTC; rw-small-beta sync p99 ~1.5s under load.
Rina Alvarez (CSM): action items: 1) Carlos to temporarily reduce canary allocation during Holloway business hours; 2) Priya to sync canary schedule with Holloway; 3) Rina to run a 20-min enablement on streaming benefits.
Carlos Mendes (SRE): I'll push a routing change to cap canary to 3% between 14:00-02:00 UTC and add a synthetic check.
Jared Holt (Holloway Analytics): that should help. target p99 <750ms for chat to keep our demos stable.
Rina Alvarez (CSM): renewal risk note: Holloways trial usage is stable but spend efficiency slipped 10% due to canary-induced retries. we'll include mitigation in renewal plan.
Carlos Mendes (SRE): command used to pull these metrics if anyone wants to replicate:
```
redwoodctl metrics query --start=1699992000 --end=1700596800 \
  --group-by="route,model,streaming_mode" --quantiles=0.95,0.99
```
Priya Kapoor (Onboarding): I'll message their eng lead and propose demo slots next Tue/Wed. recommend we demo streaming with parallelism=4 to highlight p95 improvements.
Rina Alvarez (CSM): Jared — can you confirm which flows were used in Wed demo so we test the same ones in our enablement?
Jared Holt (Holloway Analytics): mainly 3-step conversation + live rerank. I'll send the flow examples in a DM.
AlertBot: synthetic-check scheduled: chat.completions cadence=30s start=2101000700
Rina Alvarez (CSM): will post an updated p95/p99 snapshot after the routing change. thanks team :thumbsup:
Jared Holt (Holloway Analytics): thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Carlos Mendes (SRE): monitoring the tail now; will reopen if p99 doesn't improve after tweak.
Rina Alvarez (CSM): closing thread for now.
